scope: Independent runtime API audit and targeted corrections; not a complete product, corporate MCP, model quality, or Windows acceptance
candidate: Uncommitted jointly edited candidate; final release provenance must bind the final commit separately

verification.command: cd app && npx vitest run tests/agent-runtime.test.ts tests/ui-mcp-native.test.ts tests/ide-mcp.test.ts tests/operations-gateway.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts tests/role-routing.test.ts tests/prompt-binding.test.ts

corrections.issue: Advertised agent_spawn always passed the forbidden manual profileId to session.create
corrections.mechanism: Atomic host agent.spawn with durable operationId; optional advisory profile hint; exact authenticated parent binding
corrections.verification: Actual MCP HTTP to WorkbenchService, concurrent retry deduplication, changed-payload rejection, invalid and foreign scope rejection

corrections.issue: recover could reset a newly admitted turn while awaiting retirement of the old process
corrections.mechanism: Synchronous per-session configuring reservation and durable queue pause before process disposal
corrections.verification: Deterministic disposal barrier and simultaneous send/resume/pump; exact continuation and preserved checkpoint

corrections.issue: Bounded checkpoints lacked a way to retrieve omitted task scope and plan details
corrections.mechanism: Versioned task_context character/item pages with explicit lengths/truncation and scope validation
corrections.verification: Oversized description exact roundtrip; plan pages and long todo detail retrieval; foreign and invalid cursor rejection

corrections.issue: Agent status returned unbounded child lists and large output tails
corrections.mechanism: Default 10/max 20 workers, 1500 UTF-8 byte result tails, 64 KiB final response cap
corrections.verification: 25 workers and large CJK/emoji output; pages 20+5, intact tail, no replacement characters, explicit truncation and foreign scope rejection

corrections.issue: Superseded ACP binding reused a still-valid bearer; slow upload could pass old initial authentication
corrections.mechanism: New random bearer at every binding; explicit revokeBinding lifecycle hook; authentication initially, after body consumption, and before tool dispatch; cancelled ACP process retired at a terminal boundary before continuation
corrections.verification: Old bearer returns 401; independent session remains usable; deterministic partial-body rotation returns 401 with zero invocations; immediate revoke and actual Workbench compact retire old binding; cancel→resume uses a different ACP PID and a fresh usable MCP binding with checkpoint

corrections.issue: Historic instruction fingerprints were not discoverable through agent history and a retained version needed session-bound retrieval
corrections.mechanism: instruction_snapshot reads only hashes referenced by the bound conversation; task_history lists current and per-message fingerprints; immutable content is bound into the instruction manifest
corrections.verification: Actual MCP HTTP across analyst→reviewer execution: old instructions remain retrievable as reference, current binding is unchanged, valid foreign stored snapshot and forged scope/hash/offset are rejected

corrections.issue: Prepared and completed conversations accumulated unlimited warm ACP processes
corrections.mechanism: Serialized LRU pool bounds safe idle processes to maxConcurrent, reserves admission before yielding, persists checkpoint and closes/revokes binding before owned disposal; recently used processes are reused
corrections.verification: Prepare four owners with cap two; hot reuse retains the same PID; active and queued owners remain protected; eviction resumes in a different PID with checkpoint, full retained history, historical instruction snapshot and fresh MCP bearer, without replay

corrections.issue: CLI could accept cancel notification but never return a terminal prompt response
corrections.mechanism: Bounded 10-second cancellation watchdog (50ms fixture override), owned process retirement and durable UNKNOWN/paused state for dispatched work; priority input is preserved and automatic replay refused
corrections.verification: Ignoring-cancel fixture reaches UNKNOWN, preserves priority input and blocks queue.resume until explicit recovery; both fresh startup and warm-client routing cancellation preserve undispatched input and retire revoked bindings

corrections.issue: A worker inherited parent.model rather than the actual accepted ACP model configuration
corrections.mechanism: Atomic spawn clones accepted parent configValues into a separate child map; pending changes are excluded; model is restored first against the child catalog, then reasoning
corrections.verification: Parent model switched to fixture-reasoning with low reasoning; child actual prompt uses both values, and a later parent switch to fixture-fast does not change the second child prompt

sensitiveNegativeControls.method: Isolated compiled baseline, same process-retirement barrier, no production source mutation

sensitiveNegativeControls.baseline: HEAD MCP handler with rotation added but without post-body recheck
sensitiveNegativeControls.method: Isolated compiled baseline and deterministic partial-body barrier; fake host invoker only

sensitiveNegativeControls.observation: Qwen tool budget 0 blocks advertised write_file before execution; budget 1 creates the controlled sentinel
sensitiveNegativeControls.method: Actual Qwen 0.25.1 against loopback SSE fixture, no real LLM or external credentials
sensitiveNegativeControls.additionalStructuredGuard: Dedicated small classifier system + profile-enum JSON schema + two-turn limit + ordinary-tool budget zero: pure structured_output exits 0 and parses reviewer; a mixed batch containing write_file before structured_output also exits 0 with no write.
sensitiveNegativeControls.currentRouterGuard: Actual current routeWithQwen in separate environment-isolated workers: invalid JSON, invalid role and forbidden tool response each cause two classifier-only attempts and two local provider requests, then return reviewer without writes, MCP startup, inherited system prompt or system dump. Six eager tools are excluded; twelve other declarations remain, protected by the zero-execution budget.
sensitiveNegativeControls.exploratoryExclusion: Literal wildcard leaves 10 declared tools; explicit 18 leaves five; explicit 22 leaves zero. The 22-tool alternative is not the selected runtime because separate live-model evaluation found worse behavior.

remainingLimits.detail: Revocation blocks requests not yet admitted to host tool dispatch. An already admitted action may have effects; preserve operation IDs/receipts, reconcile observed state, and never claim revocation rolls back a remote write.
This slice is not a full DAG/lease/quota/worktree-isolation scheduler. Shared workspace requires actual coordination and verified ownership.
Non-permission tool question interruption and timeout lifecycle still needs stronger stale-answer handling; a saved answer must not be claimed delivered to a lost tool invocation.
Global reference notes and retained transcripts exist; complete scoped project knowledge, semantic decision indexing and exhaustive untruncated raw event capture are not proved by role instructions.
No comparative old/new LLM quality evaluation and no workplace GigaCode 26.10.6 acceptance. Qwen loopback fixtures prove protocol guard behavior, not model intelligence or corporate compatibility.

Only safe idle executors count toward the LRU warm pool cap (equal to maxConcurrent). Active, queued, configuring and unresolved owners are deliberately excluded; this is not a hard cap on all process memory. The 10-second cancellation deadline stops only the owned CLI process; external operations may still require reconciliation. No TTL or extra background runtime controller is introduced.
